item_summary: $30-50 vertically oriented ergonomic wireless mouse with adjustable DPI and programmable side buttons to reduce wrist strain
detailed_item_draft: Procure a vertical ergonomic wireless mouse within the $30 to $50 USD range. Design must enforce a 57-degree vertical orientation to maintain a neutral handshake grip and reduce pronation. Connectivity must be wireless via 2.4GHz USB receiver or Bluetooth 5.0, with battery longevity of at least 6 months per charge or battery set. Optical sensor must offer adjustable DPI from 1000 to 4000 via a dedicated top button. Hardware must include a minimum of two programmable side buttons with driver software for macro assignment. Scroll wheel must support tilt functionality for horizontal navigation. Surface texture should be matte with a soft-touch thumb rest. Weight must not exceed 115g. OS compatibility required for Windows 10/11 and macOS. Product must include a 12-month manufacturer warranty.
